metadata.title: Surrealist New Wave Portrait Layout
useCases: Post-punk or New Wave promotional posters

retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist composition featuring two mirrored figures connected by an elongated, sculptural hair element forming an 'S' curve, overlaid with vertical hand-drawn script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically oriented composition where two identical figures are positioned at opposite corners, one upright and one inverted. Their hair is extended into a thick, textured black rope that snakes through the center of the frame in a large 'S' shape. A vibrant, scratchy red script is layered vertically over the central hair element, while a white sticker-like graphic sits in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Rotational symmetry between the two human figures
Intertwining of organic hair texture with fluid script
High contrast between black silhouettes and warm yellow background
Juxtaposition of raw hand-lettering against clean geometric sticker elements
coreInvariants: The 'S' curve hair connection between the two heads
Vertical orientation of the primary display text
Warm yellow-to-cream radial or linear gradient background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the bottom-left and top-right corners, scaled to roughly one-third of the height each.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central 'S' curve of the hair rope acts as the primary structural spine.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the hair rope from the bottom figure, up through the central script, to the inverted top figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the top-left and bottom-right, though the latter is occupied by a graphic insert.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow gradient background providing a high-energy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the figures and hair rope, creating strong silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the central script and sticker highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and yellow, with extreme value contrast provided by the black elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, elongated cursive script with vertical orientation.
letterConstructionRules: Scratchy, uneven stroke widths suggesting a brush or marker
Elongated ascenders and descenders that bleed into the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature sharp, needle-like terminals
Lowercase letters are compressed horizontally and stretched vertically
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, expressive hand-lettering paired with clean, functional geometric sans-serif for secondary info.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main script
avoid: Horizontal typesetting for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the scratchy, hand-drawn energy of the original.
For the secondary sticker text to maintain a clean, punchy look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait with two figures in black clothing at opposite corners (one inverted). Connect their heads with a thick, textured black rope forming an 'S' shape against a yellow gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, scratchy red hand-lettering over the central rope. Place a white rectangular sticker with a red 'X' and circular black text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text oriented vertically?
Do the two figures have a rotational symmetry relationship?
Is the hair rope textured and thick?
Is the background a warm yellow gradient?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact wording of the sticker text

avoid: Clean, digital-looking vector lines for the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is legible despite its scratchy nature.
Verify the 'S' curve connects both figures seamlessly.
Check that the inverted figure feels intentional and balanced.
Confirm the sticker element looks like a physical overlay.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take two mirrored subjects, link them with a central organic texture, and bisect the composition with a vertical, high-contrast gestural script.
